notes:
• Stremio add-ons with direct links (Plexio for your Plex server, and others): sources show the add-on's own name, the real file size, which kind of stream it is (Direct Play, Transcode 720p) with the right quality, and subtitle files the add-on provides
• Dolby Vision that a TV can't do (profile 7 remuxes on many TVs, Sony's included) now plays its HDR10 picture with the right colours instead of wrong ones. TVs that do Dolby Vision keep it. New setting: Dolby Vision › Play as HDR10
• Trakt: when Trakt stops accepting this device's sign-in, ValFlix now says so (Settings › Accounts and a message on Home) instead of showing empty rows. Select Trakt there to link it again
• Player: OK now brings up the controls; OK again (on the seek bar) pauses
• Player: new Picture choice under Audio & Subtitles › Sound, Picture & Speed: Fit, Fill, Stretch or Zoom, remembered on each device
• Info panel shows the TV's real output resolution (built-in TVs draw menus at 1080p but play video at 4K)
